results.name: sampled scratch restore works through HTTP and reports sample and total separately
tampering content, metadata or the complete manifest fails validation before drill
wrong type, extra restore controls and non-JSON backup body are rejected
empty snapshot or all-unknown settings cannot give a pass
invalid known setting is rejected even if attacker recomputes the plain checksum
mixed current, locked and unknown settings are honestly reported as skipped
legacy bundle can be drilled non-destructively but is labelled legacy with warning
duplicate paths, parent-as-file, unsafe paths and invalid binary input are refused even with a new manifest
a ciphertext envelope sent directly to the server is not treated as a decrypted bundle
